grouping: Union exact pixels, 63-bit DCT hash Hamming <=8, and translated matches (thumbnail NCC >=0.88; 100x100 center NCC >=0.95; full overlapping region NCC >=0.92).
acquisition_groups: Acquisition identifiers absent from publisher XML.
channels: Publisher JPEGs decode to three equal channels. Training and inference repeat one grayscale plane.
coordinates: VOC 1-based inclusive endpoints to zero-based half-open [xmin-1,ymin-1,xmax,ymax].
